facts.heading: Client name is Tomas
facts.content: Tomas is the client's name.
facts.evidence: Good evening, Mr. Bartop

facts.heading: Client has stomach ache
facts.content: Tomas has a stomach ache and feels he cannot continue as is.
facts.evidence: I have a stomach ache, I can't do it like this.

facts.heading: Client plans to visit clinic
facts.content: Tomas plans to go to the clinic by 1 pm to check if he is closed.
facts.evidence: I'm going to the clinic to check if I'm closed.

facts.heading: Client describes repetitive routine
facts.content: Tomas describes a routine of closing doors, checking counters, and drawers repeatedly.
facts.evidence: I close the door, go to the kitchen, go back and close the door.

facts.heading: Client experiences recurring visions
facts.content: Tomas experiences a recurring vision that happens every day and lasts for a long time.
facts.evidence: Every day.

facts.heading: Client feels unable to sleep
facts.content: Tomas feels unable to sleep at night and in the morning.
facts.evidence: The worst thing is that we go to bed or sleep.

facts.heading: Client's condition started two years ago
facts.content: Tomas's condition started two years ago when neighbors were playing and he had to wake up.
facts.evidence: It started two years ago.

facts.heading: Client had fever after waking up
facts.content: Tomas had a fever a couple of days after waking up from the disturbance.
facts.evidence: A couple of days later, I had a fever.

facts.heading: Client feels like an obstacle
facts.content: Tomas feels that he is in the way and does not control himself.
facts.evidence: From that point I feel that I'm in the way.

facts.heading: Client feels paralyzed by responsibility
facts.content: Tomas feels he must stand still and do nothing if something does not control him.
facts.evidence: If something doesn't control me, I'll stand still and I'll do nothing.

facts.heading: Client feels crazy due to rapid growth
facts.content: Tomas feels like he is crazy because he grew up really fast.
facts.evidence: I grow up really fast, so I feel like I'm crazy.

facts.heading: Client wants to run away
facts.content: Tomas would rather run away than face the situation.
facts.evidence: I'd rather run away.

facts.heading: Client refers to mother Barbara
facts.content: Tomas refers to his mother as Barbara.
facts.evidence: Barbara, my mother.

facts.heading: Client feels like a child at work
facts.content: Tomas feels like a child who cannot go out of the house at work.
facts.evidence: I felt like a child who can't go out of the house.

facts.heading: Client works as a detective
facts.content: Tomas works as a detective in the police station.
facts.evidence: I'm working as a detective in the police station.

facts.heading: No job ever obtained
facts.content: Tomas has never had a job.
facts.evidence: No, never.

facts.heading: Works only one hour weekly
facts.content: Tomas spends only one hour in the office per week working.
facts.evidence: Last week I was busy with work an hour in the office.

facts.heading: Thinks about killing children
facts.content: Tomas has intrusive thoughts about killing a woman and her children.
facts.evidence: It's terrible, I would never kill them.

facts.heading: Hides thoughts from Barbara
facts.content: Tomas has not told Barbara about his intrusive thoughts.
facts.evidence: And it's the worst, when I didn't tell anyone, not even Barbara.

facts.heading: Sleeps twice nightly
facts.content: Tomas stays in his bedroom twice a night to control the room.
facts.evidence: I stay there two times a night and control the room.

facts.heading: Uses bathroom twice daily
facts.content: Tomas goes to the bathroom twice a day.
facts.evidence: The bathroom is two times a day.

facts.heading: Uses controller to manage thoughts
facts.content: Tomas uses a controller to control his thoughts and feel safe.
facts.evidence: I go back to control something, so I can do it.

facts.heading: Therapy started at hospital
facts.content: Tomas was in therapy when he went to the hospital.
facts.evidence: I was in therapy when I went to the hospital.
